column3: Compiler descriptor with name="AScript" type="ascript" and NO <step> children; the AngelScript path is compiled in-process by the bundled AngelScript engine, so the XML exists only to carry the name/type into the compiler registry.
Compiler descriptor name="Arduino" type="arduino", no <step>; the Arduino path is special-cased in InoDebugger (arduino-builder / arduino-cli), not shell-template driven.

Two-step external toolchain descriptor (avr-gcc then avr-objcopy) with $device/$buildPath/$fileName/$filePath placeholders and a separate argsDebug line - the only shipped compiler with a real command line.
Minimal sdcc stub whose type="c10" encodes the compiler-type digits documented in types.txt (1=high level, 0=no ':' in labels); arguments are empty so it never actually compiles.
The "None" compiler entry (type="none") - the sentinel that means "no toolchain" and is skipped by the debugger factory.

Documented template for authoring a compiler XML: lists the 8 supported $filePath/$fileDir/$fileName/$fileExt/$inclPath/$buildPath/$family/$device substitutions and shows a worked Avra example with a syntax="avrasm" link.
Explains the 2-digit suffix of a compiler "type" (first digit 0=asm/1=high level, second digit bit0 = label ':' style, bit1 = flash address position) - the only place this encoding is written down.
6502 assembler highlighting: directives (equ/include/org), the 56 official mnemonics as plain words, '#' preprocessor, ';' line comments, ':'-suffixed label rule.
AVR assembler highlighting with the full AVR instruction set (~180 mnemonics incl. MUL/SBI/CALL) as plain words; label rule is "^[space/tab]*\w+:".
C/C++ highlighting: data/keyword1/keyword2 plain-word rules, a '#' preprocessor regex, number regexes, an HTML-tag rule, a 'function' rule using a lookahead "\b[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?=\()".
GCBASIC highlighting with a dated WIP changelog header; its Keyword2 list (HSerPrint, LCDCMD, PWMOn ...) is capitalised, which the lower-casing highlighter can never match - those rules are dead.
Intel HEX highlighting: four column-anchored rules (ByteCount/Address/Type/Checksum) each using a background colour rather than a foreground one.

8051/i51 assembler highlighting; its directives are one regex over a dot-directive alternation while the mnemonics are plain words, and the trailing "[^\\b]" is a negated class rather than the word boundary it was meant to be.

JavaScript highlighting (a near copy of cpp.syntax with a JS keyword set); its function rule is double-escaped - the file holds "\\b[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?=\\()" where cpp.syntax holds "\b...\b" - and remQuotes() does not unescape, so the word boundary becomes a literal backslash-b and the rule never fires.
GNU-make highlighting with a negative-lookahead target rule "(?!.*:=).*:" so assignment lines are not highlighted as targets.
Markdown highlighting with 11 rules (headers, hrule, blockquote, lists, links, images, bold/italic/strike, inline code, html) and fenced code blocks expressed as a multiLineComment pair of "```".
PIC14 assembler highlighting; unlike the other assembler files it has no Label rule and calls its mnemonic list keyword1.

239-line cookbook documenting the .syntax format for Highlighter::readSyntaxFile - rules header, -style: line, plain-word vs quoted-RegExp patterns, the special multiLineComment rule, rule ordering, and the _dark.syntax theme fallback.
XML highlighting with a lookahead element-name rule "\b[A-Za-z0-9_]+(?=\=)" and a comment rule spanning "<!--.*-->".
Z80 assembler highlighting; same 8-rule shape as the 6502/avr assembler files with the Z80 mnemonics and ED-prefixed block opcodes.
SPICE-style diode model library in XML: three itemsets (diode, zener, led) whose items carry satCurr_nA, resist, emCoef and brkDown, loaded by eDiode::getModels() from a user-overridable data file.
Help for the 7-segment-with-integrated-BCD component; documents the bit ordering (bit 0 right pin, bit 3 left pin) and that PWM/multiplexing is unsupported.
ADC help; documents Size (output pin count) and Reference Voltage, then includes the shared logicoutputs and logicedges fragments.
AiP31068 I2C LCD help; documents Rows/Columns/I2C Address (62) and warns that the I2C frequency should match the master but is not critical.
Amperimeter help; documents the red/black polarity pins and that the third pin outputs the reading as a voltage updated at the circuit FPS.
AND gate help; the pure-include case - it adds no text of its own and pulls in logicinputs, gateinputs, logicoutputs, gateoutputs and gatedelay.
Application-level help; documents the Language setting and the Font Scale setting, both of which need a restart.
AT90USB162 MCU help: 32-pin QFN pin table with alternate-function names, then the datasheet feature summary (16 KB flash, 512 B EEPROM/SRAM, 22 I/O lines, 2.7-5.5 V).
Audio output help; documents the Buzzer mode and the 8-ohm impedance, and notes that a missing audio device is shown as an "X" in the symbol.
Battery help; documents Voltage (5 V) and internal Resistance (1 m-ohm).
Binary-to-decimal converter help; documents the 16-Bits property, output inversion, and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
BJT help; documents PNP (default yes), Gain (100) and the base-emitter diode threshold (0.670736 V).
Buffer help; documents input inversion, output inversion, the Tristate option (adds an active-low enable pin) and pulls in gatedelay.
Bus connector help; documents Size (8 bits) and Start bit, the bit number assigned to the first pin.
Capacitor help; documents Capacitance, Resistance, Initial Voltage and the per-component "Reactive Step" override that beats the global Simulation Settings.
Circuit-canvas help; documents Draw Grid, Show Scrollbar, Animate, Canvas Refresh (20 redraws/sec) and the 15-second auto-backup interval.
Clock source help; documents Voltage, Frequency and "Always On" which removes the on/off button.

Binary counter help; documents Use Set Pin, clock/set-reset inversion and "Count to"; includes propdelay - a fragment that does NOT exist anywhere in the repo, so this include resolves to the "No help available" placeholder.
Controlled-source help; the boolean property set (Use Control Pins, Current Source, Current Controlled, Gain) lets one component cover VCVS/CCVS/VCCS/CCCS.
Variable current source help; documents Current value and Maximum Current (must be positive).
DAC help; documents Size and Reference Voltage, and includes logicinputs/logicedges.
DC motor help; explains the green/red speed indication and that the coil is modelled as a plain resistor for speed.
Decimal-to-7-segment help; documents output inversion and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
Decimal-to-binary help; documents the 16-Bits property and input inversion, and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
Demultiplexer help; documents Address Size (3 bits => 2^3 channels) and output inversion, and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
DHT22 temperature/humidity help; documents the Model choice (HDT22/HDT11) and the 0.5-degree increment buttons.
DIAC help; documents On Resistance (500 ohm), Off Resistance (100 M-ohm), Breakdwn Voltage and Holding Current.
Standalone dial help; documents Minimum/Maximum Value and Steps, and says explicitly that the dial is meant to be LINKED to a Dialed component (potentiometer, variable resistor, resistive sensors).
Dialed-fragment help; documents the Slider-vs-Knob control choice and the Scale factor that sets the dial size.

Diode help; documents Model (read from data/diodes.model), forward voltage, max current, series resistance and the advanced saturation current / emission coefficient, and states that the diode blinks when the max current is exceeded.
DS1307 I2C real-time-clock help; documents "Set current time at start" so the sim can start from the PC clock.
DS1621 I2C temperature sensor help; documents the A0/A1/A2 address-strapping pins and the +/- temperature buttons.
DS18B20 One-Wire temperature sensor help; documents the random ROM address and the +/- temperature buttons.
Dynamic RAM help; documents row/column address sizes, data size, refresh period, the memory table / load-data / save-data context menu, and the open-drain output option.
Polarised (electrolytic) capacitor help; same four properties as the plain capacitor plus a note that it blinks when the polarity is wrong.
Ellipse help; a pure include of the shared shape fragment, so it carries no text of its own.
ESP-01 WiFi module help; states the TCP/IP AT-command support is only partial and documents Baudrate and the debug-message switch.
Fixed voltage source help; documents the 5 V output value and the left-button on/off.
Shared flip-flop fragment; documents Set/Reset inversion, Clock inversion and the Trigger Type options (Clock / enable / None hides the clock pin).
D flip-flop help; a one-line alias that includes the shared flipflopfull fragment.
Full flip-flop fragment; documents the "Use Set/Reset Pin" visibility toggle and includes the shared flipflop fragment.
JK flip-flop help; a one-line alias that includes the shared flipflopfull fragment.
RS flip-flop help; documents only the "Use Set/Reset Pin" toggle and includes the shared flipflop fragment (no trigger-type options).
T flip-flop help; a one-line alias that includes the shared flipflopfull fragment.
Frequency meter help; documents the 0.1 V filter that ignores voltage changes below the threshold.
Standalone frequencimeter help; says to connect the left pin to a wire and gives the minimum measurable frequency as 2 Hz.
Full-adder help; a bare include set (logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges) with no component-specific text.
Combinational-logic "Function" component help; documents the per-output function list syntax "i0 | i1", the input/output sizes, inversion, open drain, and links the simulide.com/p/function tutorial.
Shared gate-timing fragment; documents Gate Delay (10 ns), Rise Time (3 ns) and Fall Time (4 ns) - the numbers every digital component inherits.
Shared gate-input fragment; documents Input Size and input inversion.
Shared gate-output fragment; documents Initial High State, output inversion and the open-drain option (sink but not source).
Ground help; states it is simply a 0 V voltage source, with no properties.
HD44780 LCD help; documents Rows and Columns of characters.
HDT22 help; identical content to dht22.txt (the component id differs only in spelling) - a duplicate fragment pair.
Header connector help; documents Size and the Downwards option that points the pins at boards behind.
I2C RAM/ROM help; documents size, control code (device address), I2C frequency and the Persistent flag that makes it behave as a ROM, plus the memory-table / load / save context menu.
I2C-to-parallel converter help; documents the base control code and the I2C frequency.
ILI9341 TFT LCD help; a two-line description only (240x320 colour, SPI interface) with no properties.
Embedded-image component help; a pure include of the shared shape fragment.
Inductor help; documents Inductance, Resistance, Initial Current and the per-component Reactive Step override.
Keypad help; documents Rows, Columns and the Key Labels string (123456789*0#) read left-to-right, top-to-bottom.
KS0108 LCD driver help; documents the CS Active Low option.
KY-023 resistive joystick help; a two-line description telling the user to click and move the circle.
KY-040 rotary encoder help; documents Steps per Rotation (20).
Incandescent lamp help; documents the filament Resistance and the Max Current that corresponds to maximum brightness.
Latch help; documents channel count, the Trigger Type (Enable / Clock / None) and the Tristate enable pin, and pulls in the shared logic fragments.
LDR help; documents the dial-driven Lux range, the Gamma exponent and R1, and links the dialed fragment.
LED help; documents Color, the Grounded option (cathode wired internally, existing cathode wires deleted), forward voltage, max current and series resistance.
LED bar help; documents Color, Size (8 leds) and the same Grounded/fwd-voltage/current trio as the single LED.
LED matrix help; documents Rows, Columns and the Vertical Pins option that moves all pins to the top and bottom.
RGB LED help; documents Common Cathode and a SEPARATE forward voltage, max current and resistance per R/G/B channel (2.4 V red, 3.5 V green and blue).
Line component help; a pure include of the shared shape fragment.
Logic-analyser help; documents the 8 channels, screen size, 100000-sample buffer, ground impedance, and the VCD export options (base time step, export at pause).
Shared logic-timing fragment; documents Propagation delay (in gates), Gate Delay, Rise Time and Fall Time - the analogue timing that backs every digital edge.
Shared logic-input fragment; documents the 2.5 V low-to-high and high-to-low thresholds and the 100 M-ohm input impedance.
Shared logic-output fragment; documents Output High Voltage (5 V), Output Low Voltage (0 V) and the 40-ohm output impedance.
MAX72xx matrix help; documents the LED colour and the size expressed as a number of 8x8 sections.
ATmega1280 help: 100-pin TQFP pin table with all alternate functions, then the full Atmel feature summary (128 KB flash, 4 KB EEPROM, 8 KB SRAM, 86 I/O lines, 16 PWM channels).
ATmega644 (mega1284 alias) help: 40-pin PDIP pin table and a short feature summary.
ATmega128RFA1 help: 64-pin QFN pin table plus the long 2.4 GHz radio feature list (ZigBee/802.15.4, AES, TRX).
ATmega128RFR2 help: same 64-pin QFN pin table as the RFA1 with the RFR2 feature list (PLL channel spacing, multi-PAN filtering).
ATmega16 help: 40-pin PDIP pin table and a compact feature summary.
ATmega164 help: 40-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT24-31 interrupt pins and a feature summary.
ATmega168 help: 28-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT0-23 and a feature summary (16 KB flash, 1 KB SRAM, 23 I/O lines).
ATmega169 help: 64-pin QFN pin table including the 4x25 segment LCD driver pins, plus the feature summary.
ATmega16M1 help: 32-pin QFN/TQFP pin table with CAN, LIN and 4 analog comparators, plus a feature summary.
ATmega2560 help: 100-pin TQFP pin table and the long feature summary (256 KB flash, 16 PWM channels).
ATmega32 help: 40-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary.
ATmega324 help: 40-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT24-31 and a feature summary.
ATmega324A help: byte-for-byte the same pin table and summary as mega324.txt - a duplicate fragment pair.
ATmega328 help: 28-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT0-23 and a feature summary (32 KB flash, 2 KB SRAM).
ATmega32u4 help: 44-pin QFN pin table including the USB D+/D- pins and 12 ADC channels, plus a feature summary.
ATmega48 help: 28-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (4 KB flash, 512 B SRAM).
ATmega64 help: 64-pin TQFP pin table including the ATmega64-only PEN pin and a feature summary.
ATmega644 help: 40-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT24-31 and a feature summary.
ATmega8 help: 28-pin PDIP pin table without PCINT and a feature summary noting the 4.5-5.5 V operating range.
ATmega88 help: 28-pin PDIP pin table with PCINT0-23 and a feature summary (8 KB flash, 1 KB SRAM).
Static RAM/ROM help; documents Address Size, Data size, Persistent (acts as ROM) and Asynchronous, and the memory-table / load / save context menu.
MOSFET help; documents P Channel, Depletion mode, RDSon and the gate-source threshold voltage.
Multiplexer help; documents Address Size (3 bits => 8 channels), input inversion, and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
Analog multiplexer help; documents Address Size and the 1 m-ohm channel impedance.
Op-amp help; documents Gain, Output Impedance, the V+/V- supply values and the "Use Supply Pins" switch.
OR gate help; a pure include set of logicinputs/gateinputs/logicoutputs/gateoutputs/gatedelay.
Oscilloscope help; documents the 4 channels, the 600000-sample buffer, screen size, ground impedance and the expandable floating window, and links the simulide.com/p/oscilloscope tutorial.

Package-component help; documents Type, Width/Height in grid cells, the Name field with its "Package" magic value, the Package File path, the Background image and the Logic-Symbol vs Chip representation switch.
PCD8544 LCD help; a two-line description of the 48x84 pixel controller with a serial bus interface.
Potentiometer help; documents the 1 k-ohm resistance and the dial-driven Current Value, and links the dialed fragment.
Logic/voltage probe help; documents the hover-or-connect behaviour, the orange=High / blue=Low colour code, the voltage label toggle and the 2.5 V logic threshold.
Push-button help; documents Normally Closed, the pole count and the Key character that lets the button be pressed from the PC keyboard.
Voltage-rail help; states it is a simple voltage source and documents the 5 V rail value.
Rectangle component help; a pure include of the shared shape fragment.
Electromagnetic relay help; documents Normally Closed, Double Throw, poles, the IOn/IOff activation currents, and the coil inductance/resistance/Reactive Step.
Resistor help; a single property, Resistance (100 ohm).
Resistor-DIP help; documents Resistance, Size and the Pullup option that converts the whole DIP into pull-ups tied to a Pullup Voltage and hides the top pins.
RTD help; documents the dial-driven temperature range, the Current Value, the Dial Step and R0, and links the dialed fragment.
SCR help; documents Gate Resistance and the two holding currents (10 mA to start conducting, 8.2 mA to keep conducting) - the duplicate label in the source is a copy/paste slip.
Serial-port help; documents Auto Open, Port Name and the baud/data/stop bit configuration, and warns the port must exist in the PC with read/write permission.
Serial-terminal help; documents the baud/data/stop bits and the Rx/Tx wiring, and links the simulide.com/p/serial-terminal tutorial.
Servo help; documents Speed (time for 60 degrees) and the min/max pulse widths that map to 0 and 180 degrees, and includes logicinputs.
Seven-segment help; documents Color, Size, Vertical Pins, Common Cathode, forward voltage, max current and series resistance.
Shared graphical-shape fragment; documents Size X/Y in pixels, Border width, the Z-Value stacking order and the colour plus opacity.
Shift-register help; documents Clock Inverted, Reset Inverted, output inversion and open drain, and includes logicinputs/logicoutputs/logicedges.
Simulation-settings help; documents Simulation Speed % and Steps per Second as two views of the same knob, the nonlinear Max Iterations, the Reactive Step and the Slope Steps for output edges.
Socket connector help; documents Size and links the SimulIDE 1.0.0 socket video.
HC-SR04 help; documents the clever trick that feeding a voltage on the In pin simulates a distance, with volts equal to metres (1.5 V = 1.5 m).
SSD1306 OLED help; documents the 128x64 size, the Rotate option for libraries that do not rotate, and the I2C address/frequency.
Stepper-motor help; documents Bipolar, Steps per Rotation and the per-winding resistance, noting the coils are modelled as resistors.
Force-sensor help; documents the dial-driven Newton range, the Current Value, the Dial Step and the reference/current temperature.
Subcircuit help; documents that a subcircuit is a component made of other parts, is described by TWO files (circuit + package), and can be shown as a chip or a logic symbol.
Two-position switch help; documents Normally Closed, Double Throw, poles and the Key character for keyboard activation.
Switch-DIP help; documents Size, the Exclusive option (only one switch closed at a time) and the Common Pin option.
Text-box component help; documents margin, border, background colour and opacity, and the font family/colour/size plus the Fixed Width option and the editable text.
NTC thermistor help; documents the dial-driven temperature range, Current Value, Dial Step, the B beta parameter and R25, and links the dialed fragment.
ATtiny13 help: 8-pin PDIP pin table (with the multi-function PB5 reset/ADC0/PCINT5 pin) and a feature summary (1 KB flash, 64 B SRAM).
ATtiny2313 help: 20-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (2 KB flash, 18 I/O lines).
ATtiny2313A help: identical pin table and summary to tiny2313.txt - a duplicate fragment pair.
ATtiny24 help: 14-pin PDIP pin table with the dual ADC (8+12 channel) and a feature summary.
ATtiny25 help: 8-pin PDIP pin table with the multi-function PB0/PB1 pins and a feature summary.
ATtiny4313 help: 20-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (4 KB flash, 256 B SRAM).
ATtiny44 help: 14-pin PDIP pin table with the dual ADC and a feature summary (4 KB flash).
ATtiny45 help: 8-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (4 KB flash, 256 B SRAM).
ATtiny84 help: 14-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (8 KB flash, 512 B SRAM).
ATtiny85 help: 8-pin PDIP pin table and a feature summary (4 KB flash, 512 B SRAM).
Resistive touchpad help; documents the 240x320 pixel size, the Transparent flag and the four edge resistances RxMin/RxMax/RyMin/RyMax.
Transformer help; documents Coupling Coefficient, Base Inductance and the per-side Primary/Secondary coil lists, and states that any coil can act as the primary.
Triac help; documents Gate Resistance and the two holding currents (10 mA to start, 8.2 mA to keep) - the duplicate label is a copy/paste slip.
Tunnel help; documents the Id that links tunnels together and the Bus flag that makes a tunnel carry a bus.
Variable-resistor help; documents the dial-driven Minimum/Maximum Resistance, Current Value and Dial Step, and links the dialed fragment.
Variable voltage source help; documents Current value plus the Maximum/Minimum Voltage bounds, which may be negative but must straddle zero.
Voltmeter help; documents the red/black polarity pins and that the third pin outputs the reading as a voltage updated at the circuit FPS.
Voltage-regulator help; a single property, Output Voltage (1.2 V) referenced to the R pin.
Wave-generator help; documents the six wave types, Frequency, Phase shift, Quality (steps per cycle), Duty, Always On, and the Bipolar/Floating/Middle Voltage/Semi amplitude options.
WS2812 LED-string help; documents only Rows and Columns of LEDs.
XOR gate help; a pure include set of logicinputs/gateinputs/logicoutputs/gateoutputs/gatedelay, with a stray "Configurable Buffer Gate" line in the source.
Zener help; documents the Model (read from data/diodes.model), forward voltage, max current, resistance, breakdown voltage, saturation current and emission coefficient.

20x20 RGBA PNG of a square IC package with a dot marker, a near-duplicate of ic2.png - the icon for the subcircuit category.
